# Bear Cave Drive Thru

> Wadsworth, Ohio's drive-thru beverage store. Pull your car into the lane that runs
> through the building and pick up cold beer, wine, seltzers, soda, snacks, candy,
> Ohio Lottery, and tobacco without leaving your seat. Locally owned and operated.

Address: 474 College St, Wadsworth, OH 44281
Phone: (330) 334-3887
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BEARCAVEWADSWORTH
Hours: Mon-Wed 8 AM-9 PM · Thu-Fri 8 AM-10 PM · Sat 9 AM-10 PM · Sun 10 AM-9 PM
Google rating: 4.7 from 17 reviews

## Pages

- [Home](https://bear-cave-drive-thru.netlify.app/): What the drive-thru is and how it works
- [Products](https://bear-cave-drive-thru.netlify.app/products/): Beer, wine & seltzers, soda & mixers, snacks & candy, Ohio Lottery, tobacco, with photos of the actual coolers
- [Catering](https://bear-cave-drive-thru.netlify.app/catering/): Beverage catering for weddings, office events, and parties
- [Jobs](https://bear-cave-drive-thru.netlify.app/jobs/): Online application; also hiring in person and via Facebook
- [Contact](https://bear-cave-drive-thru.netlify.app/contact/): Hours, map, phone, message form, FAQ

## Facts

- Drive-thru format: the lane passes through the building; staff fetch items and take payment at your car window
- Walk-up customers welcome during open hours
- Alcohol and tobacco require a valid ID, 21+
- Official Ohio Lottery retailer
- Beverage catering available for events; call (330) 334-3887
- No online ordering; all sales in person
